action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that cgit incorrectly handled repository paths when HTTP
cloning was enabled. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
access files outside the repository and obtain sensitive information.
isummary: cgit could be made to expose sensitive information over the network.

cgit.description: hyperfast web frontend for git repositories written in C

title: cgit vulnerability
